title: Zrike All Over Mickey & Minnie Salad Plate Disney
descriptionText: This Zrike salad plate features an all-over mickey and minnie design, perfect for any Disney lover's dinner party. The 8-inch width ceramic plate is both durable and stylish, making it a great addition to any kitchen or home. The black color adds a touch of elegance to any table setting and the Disney franchise design is sure to impress any guest. This plate is perfect for serving salads or any other dish and is sure to be a cherished part of your collection.
